comments.author: Alexander Terp
comments.body:
Done, and the open question in the card answered: **the gate fails when attribution stops describing what ships.** `./dev` runs `python3 tools/licenses.py --check` beside the corpus check, on the same argument - a file checked in to describe something that nothing else notices has gone stale, and a dependency arrives inside a change about something else entirely, so nobody reviewing that change is thinking about licenses. It reads the registry cargo already filled during the build, so it stays offline.

Three gaps were covered, all of them invisible from the bundle's own contents because all three are compiled into binaries rather than copied beside them: 59 Rust crates linked into `libmuster.dylib`, `muster-cli` and `muster-bridge`; swift-protobuf, whose runtime links into the app executable; and ten of the Zig packages libghostty is built from, carried in by its static archive. `licenses/THIRD-PARTY.md` and `licenses/GHOSTTY-EMBEDDED.md` are generated by `tools/licenses.py` and `tools/ghostty-embeds.py`, and `build_bundle` stages the first into `Contents/Resources`.

creator: Alexander Terp
description:
NOTICE covers Ghostty and herdr, and build_bundle stages licenses/herdr/LICENSE into muster.app. Nothing covers swift-protobuf (Apache-2.0, pinned at 1.38.1 in Package.resolved), whose runtime library is linked into the shipped binaries rather than only generating code at build time - nor the ~90 Rust crates in Cargo.lock that end up inside libmuster.dylib and muster-bridge.

Deferrable while nothing works yet and nothing leaves this machine, which is why this is not in next. It stops being deferrable the first time --bundle output goes to somebody outside the project, and that is the kind of thing that happens on a day nobody planned it. Worth doing before then rather than after.

The mechanical half is easy - cargo-about or cargo-bundle-licenses can generate the Rust set - so most of the work is deciding what the bundle should carry and where, and whether the gate should fail when a new dependency arrives without a license beside it.
title: 📜 The bundle ships licenses it does not carry
